notes.title: Update #1
ETD Trading Cards
notes.content:
[b]Dear friends![/b]

First, we would like to express our deep gratitude for you supporting our first project — Escape the Darkness. Gamers from all around the world obtain it! We are happy to read your reviews: some of your ideas will be brought to life in new, more exciting and larger scale projects.

The most popular question you ask is if we introduce trading cards to Escape the Darkness. The thing is — the recent change in the associated Steam policies requires a game to pass a certain sales threshold to enable this feature. We have already prepared trading cards and as soon as we reach the required sales result — they will appear in Steam!

Stay with us — a lot of fun is on the horizon!

Yours sincerely,
Indie Ninjas team.

notes.title: Escape the Darkness sales have begun
notes.content:
[b]Dear players![/b]

We, the Indie Ninjas team, are happy to announce: today, on the 3rd of April 2018, our videogame Escape the Darkness will be officially released in Steam.

Escape the Darkness is an adventure Endless Runner game. You are Beralt, one of the three brothers born in a magnificent kingdom of Cyvia. The brothers grew as fierce warriors and were always together until the fate separated them. Later on, yet again fighting the undead, the youngest brother made a fatal mistake. This is how this story begins...

Escape the Darkness is the first project of the Indie Ninjas company. We’ve carefully plotted the story, threw in a handful of references, gave birth to original game mechanics, amassed our party by adding famous streamers to our companion rooster and translated our creation into many wondrous languages. The preparations for the journey have been completed — now go on and have fun in the comfortable game world we have created for you.

Thank you for being our swords in the darkness!
